topics.name: State Machine Identity
topics.purpose: Define reusable lifecycle/state-machine semantics as an explicit identity with exact states, transitions, guards and terminal behavior.

semantics.identity_rule: Each state machine has explicit identity/version.
semantics.terminal_rule: Terminal states are explicit where present.
semantics.invalid_rule: Unlisted transition is invalid unless extension semantics explicitly allow it.
semantics.authority_rule: State machine definition grants no transition authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: terminal state inferred from word closed
